title: Ivy League Scores Plummet: AI's Role

scenes.text: An Ivy League professor found AI may be a learning barrier, not a help.
After enforcing in-person finals, scores dropped by half, raising eyebrows.
This incident shines a light on AI's influence in modern education.
In-person exams are back, questioning AI's true impact.
